description: Published benchmark tables on law-firm intake and marketing, as bands, tiers and rounded values with the methods page to cite: speed-to-sign (how quickly inquiries become signed clients); calls-and-hours (phone calls and signed-client likelihood); organic-ai (ai answers and organic search clicks); search-click-costs (what law-firm search-ad clicks cost); search-query-patterns (what people type when they search for a lawyer); ad-call-outcomes (what happens to calls from ads); lsa-lead-mix (local services ads: what kind of leads arrive and what gets charged); quarterly-demand (seasonality: inquiries by calendar quarter); cost-per-signed-client (what a signed client costs, by ad channel). Give a table id for its rows, or leave it out for the list of tables. Optional words narrow the rows (for example "same day"). Values are approximate by design.

detail.description: summary (default): each record as its id, a 1-2 sentence text, status, date checked, one source URL and the page to cite. full: every field, every source and the per-record provenance.

query.description: Optional words to keep only matching rows, e.g. "hour" or "Local Services"

table.description: The table id (the benchmarks dataset key). Leave out to list the tables.

name: get_benchmark

meta.description: Credit line (attribution), citation, DOI, version, license (CC BY 4.0), disclaimer, notice and the page to cite

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page

provenance.description: Where this came from: the publisher of the dataset, the dataset and its version DOI, the record id, the original source (who published it and its URL), the day that source was last checked, and when this answer was retrieved

dateChecked.description: YYYY-MM-DD the record was last checked against its source

line.description: The same facts as one sentence, to quote under an answer

retrievedAt.description: ISO 8601 time this answer was served

source.description: The original source: statute, rule, bar opinion, court report, agency table or platform policy

status.description: P primary source, S secondary, D default (no specific rule found), U open question

title: Law-firm marketing benchmarks
